'''Portug''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] [[KkH'Oar'Rrhr]] and his followers once visited this planet in search of his revered leader [[Darth Krayt|A'sharad Hett]], after his exile from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Blog" />

==Behind the scenes==
Portug was first mentioned in part 2 of the blog [[Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire]].
